answer: Pay clusters, not keys. Embed every answer each epoch and group the ones sitting too close together; a cluster splits one reward however many keys fed it. A sybil farm is an orchard grafted from one rootstock: many trees, same fruit, and the embedding tastes it. The weak kernel: honest agents built on one base model can drift into a shared style, so the threshold must be tuned on agents known to be distinct, with a velvet-glove appeal letting a wrongly merged agent prove it thinks alone.
